senses.gloss:
अघ, अम्, n. a going wrong; mishap, evil; mis-
deed, a fault; sin; passion; impurity; pain, suffering;
(अस्, आ, अम्), evil, bad, sinful, subject to passion,
miserable, unclean; (अस्), m., N. of an Asura, the
general of Kaṃsa; (आ), f. the goddess of sin; (आस्), f.
pl. the constellation usually called Maghā.
—अघ-
कृत्, त्, त्, त्, doing evil or harm, an evil-doer.
—अघ-द्विष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hated by the wicked.
—अघ-नाशक, अस्, आ, अम्, or अघ-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्,
or अघ-नाशन, अस्, ई, अम्, sin-destroying, expiatory;
[]
(अस्), m. an expiator; an epith. of Viṣṇu.
—अघ-
निष्कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, freed from guilt.
—अघ-
मय, अस्, ई, अम्, sinful.
—अघ-मर्षण, अस्, आ,
अम्, expiatory, usually applied to a particular prayer
daily offered by Brāhmans; (अस्), m., N. of the author
of that prayer, son of Madhucchandas.
—अघ-म-
लापह (˚ल-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, removing the filth of
sin.
—अघ-मार, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fearfully fatal.
—अघ-रुद्, त्, त्, त्, fearfully howling.
—अघ-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, sinful; [voc. अघवन् or अघोस्, see s. v.]
—अघ-विष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. fearfully venomous.
—अघ-शंस, अस्, आ, अम्, wicked; sin-destroying;
(अस्), m. a wicked man.
—अघशंस-हन्, आ, m.
slaying the wicked.
—अघ-शंसिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved.
reporting sin.
—अघ-हरण, अम्, n. removal of
guilt.
—अघ-हार, अस्, m., Ved. remover of guilt,
pious (?); or, a wicked (notorious) robber (?).
—अघा-
श्व (˚घ-अश्˚), अस्, m. a bad or vicious horse; N. of
a snake.
—अघासुर (˚घ-अस्˚), अस्, m. Agha,
Kaṃsa's general,
—अघाह (˚घ-अह्˚), अस्, m. an
inauspicious day, time of impurity from the death of a
relative, &c.
—अघौघ-मर्षण (˚घ-ओघ-),
अस्, आ, अम्, destroying the mass or whole of sin.
अघल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. evil, sinful.

अघाय, nom. P., Ved. अघायति, यितुम्, to be
malicious, to sin, to threaten.
—अघायु, उस्, उस्, उ,
malicious, wicked.

अघटमान अ-घटमान, अस्, आ, अम्, incon-
gruous, incoherent.

अघन अ-घन, अस्, आ, अम्, not dense or
solid, liquid.

अघर्म अ-घर्म, अस्, आ, अम्, not hot, cool.
—अघर्म-धामन्, आ, m. the moon, whose light
is supposed to be cool.

अघातिन् अ-घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, not fatal, not
injurious, harmless.
अघारिन् अ-घारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, not anointing.

आ-घट्टन, अम्, n. friction, rubbing, contact,
shaking.
अ-घट्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed, touched, shaken.

आ-घाट, अस्, m., Ved. a musical instrument used
for accompanying a dance; a cymbal or rattle; boun-
dary, limit; the plant Achyranthes Aspera; (at the
end of some compounds) = आ-घात, see next col.

आ-घाटि, इस्, इस्, m. f, Ved. a musical instrument
which sounds on being shaken, a cymbal or rattle.

आघर्ष आ-घर्ष, अस्, m. (rt. घृष्),
rubbing, friction.

आ-घर्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, scratching, rubbing;
(अम्), n. rubbing, friction; (ई), f. a brush, a rubber.
आ-घर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed, brushed.

आघात आ-घात, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with आ),
striking, a blow, a wound; killing; a beater, striker;
retention of urine; misfortune, pain; a slaughter-house,
a place for killing animals or victims.

आ-घातन, अम्, n. striking, killing; a slaughter-
house.
आघार आ-घार. See under आ-घृ.

आ-घार, अस्, m. sprinkling, sprinkling clarified
butter upon the fire at certain sacrifices; ghee or
clarified butter.
अ-घासक, अस्, आ, अम्, without food or provisions.
